settings.headline: On the boards now
settings.subtitle: I take one house into construction at a time. Here is exactly where things stand, and when I can start yours.

settings.headline: Right now
settings.body:
JC-07 — Antelope Wells House is in construction outside Marfa: rammed-earth walls up, roof next. I am on site Tuesdays and Fridays.

JC-08 — a 900 sq ft cabin near Fort Davis is in drawings. Permit set goes in this winter.

That is the whole practice. No other jobs are hidden behind these.
settings.side:
Booking spring 2027 — 2 slots.

Slot 1: a house under 2,000 sq ft on land you already own.

Slot 2: a cabin, studio, or major rework of a small house.

If you need to start sooner, I will say so and suggest who to call.

settings.headline: What 'slot' means
settings.body: A slot is my drawing time, not a sales quota. When both are taken, the next start is fall 2027 and I keep a short waitlist — three names, no deposit.
settings.side: Three names max. I email the list myself when a slot opens. No drip campaign.
